products.name: School Management System
products.tagline: Run admissions, academics and fee collection from one connected platform.
products.summary: An all-in-one platform for schools to manage students, academics, staff and fee payments digitally.
products.overview: The School Management System brings every part of school administration into a single platform — from online admissions and student records to attendance, grading, timetables and report cards. Parents follow their children's progress from a mobile app and pay school fees directly through NIB digital channels, with every payment reconciled to the school's account automatically.
products.problem: Most schools still depend on paper registers, spreadsheets and cash fee collection. Records are scattered, report cards take weeks, parents queue at the bank and finance teams spend days reconciling payments. The platform replaces these manual steps with one source of truth.

products.tagline: Launch a multi-vendor online marketplace with integrated payments.
products.summary: A multi-vendor marketplace platform for businesses and associations to sell online with integrated NIB payments.
products.overview: The Digital Marketplace lets organizations launch their own online marketplace where many vendors sell to customers. Vendors manage their storefronts, products and orders; buyers pay through NIB digital channels; and the marketplace operator manages commissions, payouts and promotions.
products.problem: Businesses and associations want to sell online but building a marketplace with payments, vendor management and settlements from scratch is costly and slow.

products.name: Guess Low Win BIG
products.tagline: An interactive digital campaign platform that turns engagement into growth.
products.summary: A promotional campaign platform where customers take part through digital channels by submitting guesses — the lowest unique guess wins.
products.overview: Guess Low Win BIG is an interactive campaign platform for brands and institutions. Participants join through NIB mobile banking, the app or USSD and submit a guess for a featured prize; the lowest unique guess wins. Campaign managers configure prizes, rules and schedules, follow participation live, and verify winners with a full audit trail.
products.problem: Traditional promotions struggle to drive digital adoption and are hard to measure. Brands need engaging campaigns that run on digital channels with transparent, auditable winner selection.

faqs.question: How is the winner decided?
faqs.answer: The participant with the lowest guess that no one else submitted wins, according to the published campaign rules.

faqs.question: Can we run our own branded campaign?
faqs.answer: Yes. Campaigns are configured with your prizes, rules and branding, subject to the applicable promotion regulations.

documentation.body: Each campaign must comply with applicable promotion and lottery regulations. The campaign owner is responsible for obtaining any required permits; the product team advises during setup.
